en.headline: Health centre logs two more Legionnaires' disease cases
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said both cases last week appear sporadic, taking this year's total to 153.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said Hong Kong recorded two more Legionnaires' disease cases last week, bringing this year's total to 153.

One patient is a 67-year-old man who lives in the Southern District and has a chronic illness. The centre classified his infection as a community case. The other patient is a 55-year-old woman, also with a chronic illness, who travelled to the mainland during the incubation period. Her case was classified as imported.
The centre said an epidemiological investigation was under way. Its preliminary finding was that both infections were sporadic, with no information so far linking them to other confirmed cases.
The centre did not name the patients or give their condition. It also did not say which days last week the cases were confirmed.

zh.headline: 衞防中心上週再錄兩宗退伍軍人病
zh.dek: 初步調查顯示兩宗屬散發個案，今年累計153宗。
body: 衞生防護中心表示，上星期本港新增兩宗退伍軍人病個案，今年累計153宗。
其中一名患者是居於南區、有長期病患的67歲男子，中心把個案列為社區感染。另一名是有長期病患的55歲女子，潛伏期內曾到內地，個案列為輸入。
中心說，流行病學調查仍在進行。初步調查顯示兩宗都屬散發個案，暫無資料顯示與其他確診個案有流行病學關連。
中心沒有公布兩名病人的姓名或病情，亦沒有說明個案在上星期哪一天確診。
